pain: The calculator is credible but visually dense, and mobile visitors must complete a long assumption flow before they see the value of the estimate
revenueHypothesis: A faster, calmer calculator experience that surfaces outcomes earlier and makes assumptions easier to adjust can improve engagement and qualified SearchCrew signup intent

The page uses the existing SearchCrew orange, black, cream, and typography system with clearer hierarchy, fewer nested-card cues, and no horizontal overflow at 320px
Focused calculator tests, the web type check, the web production build, and responsive browser checks pass without console errors
The exact pushed commit passes GitHub CI and a Vercel READY preview passes the calculator buyer-path smoke test
rollback: Revert the scoped UI polish commit, restore the previous calculator presentation, remove the isolated Vercel preview deployment, and leave the Cloudflare production site and domains unchanged.
stopConditions: Stop on secret exposure, target ambiguity, paid-plan requirements, production DNS changes, more than two deployment attempts, or any regression in repository CI.
